skills.name: ADB Connection

skills.description: Query, audit, and optimize Google Ads campaigns. Supports two modes: (1) API mode for bulk operations with google-ads Python SDK, (2) Browser automation mode for users without API access - just attach a browser tab to ads.google.com. Use when asked to check ad performance, pause campaigns/keywords, find wasted spend, audit conversion tracking, or optimize Google Ads accounts.
skills.description_zh: 查询、审计和优化Google Ads广告系列。支持两种模式：(1) API模式，使用google-ads Python SDK进行批量操作；(2) 浏览器自动化模式，适用于没有API访问权限的用户，只需将浏览器标签页附加到ads.google.com。当需要检查广告表现、暂停投放/关键词、发现浪费支出、审计转化追踪或优化Google Ads账户时使用。
skills.name: Google Ads

skills.description: Activate different high-agency thinking modes to unlock better reasoning. Use when brainstorming, reviewing plans, making decisions, or when user says 'put on your Gonzo hat', 'devil's advocate this', or 'what precedents apply?'
